translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

book.name: MADIU
book.title: Madiu Madiuhanda Bi Mana Debene gili binigo ogo

content: Yasu mo tara ho hearia ti de hendenego ogo
Horo waragaru howa Yasuhanda Pidabi Yamese Yone libu hamenela henego haru halu tini hangu hole hari mbira timbuni weagoria haru iraga ho hene.

Ani howa tigua handalu hearia Yasu ibuni mo tara halu ibunaga dengui biago mo tara dege howa ni hanuni howa daragola wá taraore haraligobi halu aga biago pele dege bialu taraore demborerebi hearia de hendene.
Ani de hondowa talima piaga tebira biarume handalu hearia Mosese Elayala Yasu baba te lalu hearia de hendene.

Ani lalu heagola Pidahanda Yasuhondo lalu, Anduane Homogo-o ina ogoria kamagoni bayaledago i̱na anda nemanda mbira í̠naga mende Mosesenaga tebone Elayanaga lowa tebira hame lareyagua bia holebero, lene.

Pida ibu wene bi lalu heaore beraliba pele taraore demborerebi ti heagoria tiga tiga ibuwa beraliba biagoha howa bi la dali halu lalu, I̱ Iginiore ogoni gubalini ho kogo ibugua bi larago hale halimu, lene.
Bi ani layuago hale howa Yasunaga talima piaga biarume mogo timbuniore lowa dindini bulu palu wigi wigi bini.
Ani bu wiaria Yasu ibuwa ela halu lalu, Gi nahe heyadaba, lene.
Ani layagola ti dengala howa handalu hearia mende nahe Yasu hangu hearia hendene.
Ti harini howa dalialu howa Yasuhanda tihondo hongo howa lalu, De gandeba ale áyu handarimigoni mbirali nalami Agali Hole Ibiyago tongolo muwa mo heya haragola dege lamilimu, lene.
Ani layagola ibunaga talima piaga biarume Yasuhondo lalu, Mana lo winigo lawai haga karume Elaya ibu ala ibulebira lalu kago irane agidabe, lene.
Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Bibahende mo manda manda bulenaga Elaya ibu ala ibulebiraore.

Anigo i̱na tí langerogo Elaya ala ibiya. Ibiyagola wali agali hearume ibu manda nabi tinime ibuhondo bua biyadagua bialu haya. Ani bialu hayadagua dege Agali Hole Ibiyagohondo tigua nde mo tandaga dege holebira, lene.
Ani layagola talima piaga biarume tihondo bi o laragoni baboraya biaga Yonenaga laralo manda bu hene.
Yasuhanda igiri mbiraha dama hearia wara tagi henego ogo
Ti wali agali bu heagoria dai bialu hearia agali mbirame Yasunaga wanakuihayagi ibuwa ge duli hanga ho biruwa
lalu, Anduane-o i̱ iginihondo dara howa biamogo berene. Ibu biango bibi biaabo halu dindini pilaga bialu marungi ibu ira dedagohabi ibahabi pilaga biaga.
Ani biyagola i̱na í̠naga talima piaga biaru hearia haru ibirugola tigua ibu mo bayale nahabeheya, lene.

Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Wali agali tí mini mbiraore nawi howa mini pu tara ho haabo kamigoni. I̱na tí kamiruha horo agiru haabo holiyadabe. I̱na tí heba howa horo agiru tínaga genda yu haabo holiyadabe, lene. Ibugua ani lowa lalu, Igiri biago i̱ kogoria haru ibidaba, lene.
Haru ibiyagola Yasuhanda dama biagohondo, Tagira pu, layagola igiri biago helalu dama tagira piyagola igiri biago bayaleore hene.
Ani biyagola ibunaga talima piaga biarume ibuni hangu hearia ibuwa lalu, Iname dama wara tagi nahabehe kamago agidabe, lene.

Yasuhanda tihondo ladai bialu lalu, Tígua mini mbiraore emene wu kamigome dama wara tagi nahabehe kami. I̱na tíhondo heneneore larogo ira masada egene emeneore ngago ale mini mbiraore wu harimiyagua hari wedagohondo lalu, Ogoriani howa amugoria pu, laramigola ibu amugoha polebira. Ani buwa mbirale marubi ta nabi bibehe holeberami, lene. [
Anigo mbirale mbira beramigome ndo tomo nane howa Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi laramigo hangume dama ogonibi wara tagi holene nga, lene.]
Yasuhanda ibuni homolenenaga te halu mende lenego ogo
Talima piaga biaru Galilini mandagi íbu ngoai hayagola Yasuhanda tihondo lalu, Agali Hole Ibiyago agalihondo minu mulene tu haruagoni.
Minu mialu tigua ibu homelo baragola horo kiru howa tebonengi ibuni mo heya holebira, lene. Aniore layagola nde ibunaga talima piaga biarume daraore howa dugupeore ho hene.
Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda dagisi muni minigo ogo

Yasubi ibunaga talima piaga biarubi Kabaniama anda piyagola Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda dagisi muni miaga hearume Pida hearia ibuwa lalu, Í̠naga lawai haga kagonime Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda dagisi muni wiagabe, lene.

Ani layagola Pidahanda lalu, E̱ wiagaore, lene. Ani lowa Pida ibu andaga piyagola Yasuhanda ala lalu, Saimono-o í̠na agi manda bu kebe. Dindi bibahende hangu hangu ho ngarunaga kini karuhondo dagisi muni miradago aiwabe. Dindi uruninaga wali agalirumebe be dindi tara howa ibinirume miagabe, lene.
Ani layagola Pidahanda ladai bialu lalu, Dindi tara howa ibinirume miaga, lene. Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Anidago dindi uruninaga wali agalirume dagisi muni mulene nawidagoni.

Anigo iname o karuni mo pila holene hame nale kamago í̠na iba timbuni bedagoha puwa wena pu iba bedagoha bape habe. Wena pinagane baregonaga ne hanganeha muni kuni mbira yulebirago ogonime Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda dagisi muni i̱nagabi í̠nagabi wulene karula polebira. Kuni ogoni mo yalu iyanaga dagisi muni wule pobe, lene.
